quality.review_scope: Source-scoped preparation, characterization, sensing and computational evidence from the admitted eight-page main article and 26-page SI. Explicit source variants and contradictions are retained. Cited upstream papers are not admitted. Computational ZnS structures are models, not measured nanocrystal phases or coordinates.
missing_fields: Exact physical batch identifiers and unreported source settings remain unknown.
Analyte titration aliquot volumes, particle molarity and exact replicate counts beyond the blank minimum are not reported.
A source dash in the LOD table is neither zero nor proof of no response.
conflicts: Main text gives CX544/tetryl LOD 1.2 µg/mL; SI Table S2 gives 0.23 µg/mL. Both retained. Sources: Main PDF p.2, System Design and Synthesis; SI PDF p.19, LOD Calculations and Table S2.

Main text describes OMe608 DNT/TNT/tetryl LODs below 0.2 µg/mL; SI gives tetryl 0.21 µg/mL. Neither is silently substituted. Sources: Main PDF p.3, sensing discussion; SI PDF p.19, LOD Calculations and Table S2.
